title: Minecraft Enderman
blurb: Reversed, warped and deeply wrong, the Enderman's vwoop is the sound of a very tall creature deciding you looked at it incorrectly. Much of the mob's audio is built from reversed and pitch-shifted recordings, which is why your brain flags it as unnatural before it has worked out what it actually is. In game it marks the moment the rules change: entirely peaceful until eye contact, then absolutely not. Perfect for teleport gags, sudden appearances, or replying to somebody holding prolonged and unwelcome eye contact across a Discord call. Whatever you do, do not look up.
origin: The Enderman ambient and teleport sound from Minecraft.
